heading: Integrated campaigns & product series.
intro: My strategy connects product releases with digital campaigns, offline experiences, community activation, KOL collaborations, and institutional partnerships. These five programs show how the individual projects fit together.
provenance: Program relationships and release roles follow the user's portfolio instructions of 1 November 2026. Execution descriptions follow the existing case studies. A release sequence describes successive launches, not personal ownership of product engineering. No combined performance totals or new commercial outcomes are inferred.
